input_domain: One sealed generated PDF 1.7, exact PDF and IR and window-plan digests, physical page count and existing en-US accessibility prerequisites
known_issues: This profile inspects only page /StructParents identity, a flat /ParentTree /Nums page mapping and referenced ancestor chains; it does not validate all structural tag edges, content stream MCIDs, tag roles, reading order or every glyph.
Non-flat number trees and otherwise valid PDFs with annotation-specific parent keys are outside the accepted profile and fail closed.
A valid page slot can still omit content or misrepresent semantics; successful inspection never certifies PDF/UA or source/text equivalence.
The existing PDF parser and accessibility validator separately parse candidates; mandatory worker resource isolation remains necessary.
Unsigned receipts are observations and cannot authenticate job origin, source assertions or external reviewer approval.
The default 32-page whole-file route is unchanged; the optional 512-page/8-MiB class does not qualify complete long reports or aggregate job resources.
Only the existing en-US locale is admitted; no release delivery, scientific qualification, new dependency or host privilege is activated.

process_profile.protocol_storage: two distinct anonymous owned regular file descriptors

supported_parent_tree_profile: Flat /ParentTree /Nums mapping one sorted unique page key per physical /StructParents; strict indirect structure elements with matching /Pg and bounded /P ancestry
